static_checks.source_bound: The seven named source/test files; no whole-workspace analysis is claimed.

static_checks.verification_basis: Root execution transcript; no standalone formatter log was retained.

limits: All described runtime checks are local; GitHub Actions was not awaited.
No live mail account, OAuth sign-in, provider connection, send, move, or delete was exercised.
Local navigation tests deliberately make draft access and provider writes unavailable.
These gates qualify this bounded Mail increment, not full Outlook/Thunderbird/eM Client parity.
Unrelated incoming Office integrations require their own evidence and are not counted here.
